title: Battlepack section 14 — Actions

container.notes: Section 14 of battle_pack.bin (71-section battlepack: u32 count, count+1 u32 offsets incl. an unpadded end offset, sections 16-byte aligned with zero fill). The section itself is an st2e table: 32-byte header (magic, u32 entryCount @4, u16 entrySize @8, u32 entryListOffset @12 = 32, u32 textSectionOffset @20 = 0) followed by packed entries and zero padding to 16 bytes.

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: ASCII 'st2e' (73 74 32 65); reject the section if different.

fields.name: entryCount
fields.notes: Number of actions (the Toolkit lists name 543 rows, 0-542).

fields.name: entrySize
fields.notes: Bytes per entry; 60 (0x3C) for this section.

fields.name: unknown0A
fields.notes: Not interpreted; keep.

fields.name: entryListOffset
fields.notes: Offset of entry 0 from the section start: 32 when entryCount > 0, else 0.

fields.name: offset10
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

fields.name: textSectionOffset
fields.notes: Inline text offset; 0 on disk for this section (filled at run time). No strings are stored here.

fields.name: offset18
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output for this section).

fields.name: offset1C
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

records.name: action
records.where: st2e entries of section 14: header.entryListOffset + i*60

fields.name: battleMenuDescription
fields.notes: Help text shown in the battle menu (battle-action help block, 4000+).

fields.name: dashRangeTo
fields.notes: Dash/approach distance toward the target (tenths of a unit, animation relative).

fields.name: dashRangeFrom
fields.notes: Dash/return distance away from the target.

fields.name: knockbackChance
fields.notes: Knockback chance; only read by some formulas (msg 649).

fields.name: range
fields.notes: Cast range (tenths of a unit).

fields.name: areaOfEffectRange
fields.notes: Area-of-effect radius/size.

fields.name: areaOfEffectPositioningRange
fields.notes: Second AoE dimension: cone angle or line length depending on the shape bits; also the start/end distance of moves such as Jump (msg 616).

fields.name: formula
fields.notes: Damage/effect formula id (109 formulas, 0 = none). The formula decides which of the other fields are used (msg 655).

fields.name: chargeTime
fields.notes: Charge time before execution.

fields.name: mpOrMistCost
fields.notes: MP cost, or Mist charge cost for Mist/quickening actions.

fields.name: unknown0B
fields.notes: Unconfirmed; tentatively an esper/technick rank (Workshop label carries a question mark).

fields.name: flags1
fields.notes: Targeting and behaviour flags. The Workshop keeps it as a raw u32; bit names from the Lua Loader docs and the Toolkit.

fields.name: power
fields.notes: Base power.

fields.name: powerMultiplier
fields.notes: Power multiplier.

fields.name: accuracyRate
fields.notes: Accuracy.

fields.name: elements
fields.notes: Element(s) of the action.

fields.name: onHitRate
fields.notes: Chance to inflict statusEffects on hit.

fields.name: amountMultiplier
fields.notes: Additional/amount multiplier (Workshop: "additional power multiplier").

fields.name: unused16
fields.notes: Unused; the Workshop skips them.

fields.name: statusEffects
fields.notes: Statuses added or removed (see flags3.statusEffectActionType).

fields.name: characterAnimation
fields.notes: Character pose used while acting (Workshop: "cast animation").

fields.name: enmityAddSelfVsFoe
fields.notes: Enmity the user gains with foes when targeting a foe.

fields.name: battleMenuCategory
fields.notes: Battle-menu category the action is filed under (Attack, Magicks, Technicks …).

fields.name: enmityAddSelfVsAlly
fields.notes: Enmity the user gains when targeting an ally.

fields.name: enmityRemoveAlliesVsFoe
fields.notes: Enmity removed from the other allies when targeting a foe.

fields.name: chargeAuraAnimation
fields.notes: Aura shown while charging.

fields.name: requiredContent
fields.notes: Content id the action needs/consumes (item for item actions, ammo/loot for technicks).

fields.name: castAnimationOrEventScript
fields.notes: Effect animation id, or an event-script id when flags1.useEventScript is set (Workshop: "after animation").

fields.name: summonedPartyMember
fields.notes: Section 16 row that is summoned (espers/guests); only meaningful for summon-type actions (msg 556).

fields.name: mistCastAnimation
fields.notes: Mist/quickening related id (Toolkit and Lua docs: mist cast animation; Workshop: "mist action").

fields.name: unused2A
fields.notes: Unused; the Workshop skips them.

fields.name: flags2
fields.notes: Category and effect flags (raw u16 in the Workshop).

fields.name: inventoryMenuDescription
fields.notes: Help text in the inventory/skill menus (inventory-action help block, 10000+).

fields.name: specialCharacterAnimation
fields.notes: Link to a special character animation (Workshop: "character animation link").

fields.name: name
fields.notes: Name text id (action block, 0+).

fields.name: flags3
fields.notes: AI/targeting condition flags (Workshop: "AI target condition flags"); bits 6-15 unused.

fields.name: gambitPage
fields.notes: Gambit action-menu page, 0-10, or -1 (0xFF) if not listed.

fields.name: gambitPageOrder
fields.notes: Position on that page, 0-16, or -1 (0xFF).

fields.name: battleMemoryFlag
fields.notes: Which "battle memory" category the AI records for this action (Workshop: "enable AI flag"; Lua docs: enableBattleMemoryFlag); 255 = none.

fields.name: unused3B
fields.notes: Unused; the Workshop writes 0.

roundTrip: Edit fields in place; the record size is fixed and nothing in this section points at entries, so value edits never move data.

Copy every byte that no field interprets (unknown*/unused*/padding, unnamed bits) from the original; the Workshop writer zero-fills them (it seeks over them), so do not use its output as the byte-identical reference.
Keep the st2e header bytes verbatim except entryCount (and entryListOffset when the count goes to/from 0).
Keep the trailing zero padding that rounds the section to a multiple of 16 bytes.
If the section length changes (added/removed entries), rewrite the battlepack offset table: every later section offset and the end offset shift by the padded size delta.
flags1/flags2/flags3 are opaque words for unknown bits: set or clear only the named bits.
Write gambitPage/gambitPageOrder as signed bytes: -1 is stored as 0xFF.
Do not reorder or delete rows; other tables reference actions by row index.
gaps: Byte 0x0B: possibly an esper/technick rank; unconfirmed in every source.
flags1 bits 4, 10, 15, 18, 20, 22, 23 and flags2 bit 5 are unnamed; flags1 bits 8-9 are "battle menu type" only per the Toolkit.
Exact meaning of mistCastAnimation (0x28) and specialCharacterAnimation (0x30) value spaces.
Which fields each formula actually reads is formula-specific and undocumented here (msg 649, 655).
Units of range/dash (tenths per the Toolkit) are not verified against vanilla data.
